headline: Junta approves conditions for alternate gas contract as ship still fails to dock - NotiCel - La verdad como es - Puerto Rico News - NOTICEL
summary: Puerto Rico's junta approved conditions tied to gas company New Fortress Energy's supply for electricity generation. Units 5 and 6 of the San Juan Power Plant have been affected since September 16.
why: New Fortress Energy is a US-based liquefied natural gas company that supplies gas to power generation in Puerto Rico. Gas supply disruptions affect its electricity costs and reliability.
